Earlier, WhatsApp allowed iPhone users to add a second account within the same app. Now, according to reports, the company is exploring expanding support to up to three accounts. Here are the details.

WhatsApp to Support Up to Three Accounts

Last June, WhatsApp officially launched the multi-account feature on iPhone, allowing users to add a second account within the same app.

After several months of beta testing, the feature was officially rolled out, freeing users from having to rely on WhatsApp Business as a workaround to manage a second account.

Now, according to WABetaInfo, the app appears to be exploring an expansion of the feature, allowing users to switch between up to three accounts without having to log out.

Here is WABetaInfo's report:

The report added that each account will retain its own chat history, notifications, privacy settings, backups, and media.

WABetaInfo noted that while two accounts are sufficient for many users, the feature is useful for those who need to handle different combinations of work and personal phone numbers simultaneously.

However, the feature is still in development and has not been made available to beta testers, meaning it may take a while before it is fully rolled out.
